objective: Implement a bounded Codex VS Code runtime model catalog observation, require user confirmation and preserve UI-provided corrections separately, while accurately delimiting Claude runtime availability.
requested: use the official Codex VS Code runtime rather than treating standalone CLI absence as catalog absence
show the readable runtime model list and ask the user whether it matches; accept a direct correction from the runtime UI
preserve Claude support without claiming an unavailable official catalog source
excluded: read provider credentials, private configuration, session state, or current conversation selection
infer quality, price, or active selection from the runtime catalog
silently overwrite runtime observations with user corrections

requestedItems.description: Add and install a narrowly scoped Codex runtime catalog reader with allowlisted output and failure-safe behavior.
Update Codex and Claude shared model policy so the catalog is shown for user confirmation and correction provenance remains distinct.
Represent unavailable official Claude catalog access as unknown, with user-reported UI correction allowed.

acceptance.description: Runtime model IDs, display names, reasoning efforts and defaults are projected; free-form runtime fields are discarded.
Runtime catalog output explicitly requires user confirmation and supports a separately attributed UI correction.
A clean manifest installation contains the new executable and the active installation can query the VS Code-shipped runtime.
Two independent read-only reviews check the implementation and policy; findings are resolved or recorded.
Model catalog/policy, semantic, functional, homeostasis, routes, allocation and installation checks pass.
